correctness.rationale: For every p,q>=2, C_ef=δ_ef K_ee-K_ef² follows from differentiating the weighted tree determinant. The pseudoinverse of the Laplacian of K_p vee independent K_q has three vertex-contrast eigenspaces, giving explicit clique-edge and cross-edge current blocks. Orthogonal edge-space decomposition by clique/independent permutation symmetries produces the listed Q,T,V,Y and B± eigenvalue classes with multiplicities adding to |E|; p=2 is separately handled. Exact inequalities show smallest positive Q and det(B-TI)=q(p-2)(q-3)/(p²(p+q)³), with B22-T<0; consequently the top eigenspace switches B+ (q=2), B+=T (q=3), T (q>=4) for EVERY p>=3. Independent direct Laplacian-pseudoinverse covariance diagonalization matched the claimed complete spectrum at (2,2),(2,3),(2,5),(3,2),(3,3),(3,4),(4,2),(5,6), while bundled exact rational small-tree enumeration provides independent entry checks. No spectral conclusion is inferred solely from matching two finite traces.
residual_risks: The spectrum and condition number are for uniform random spanning trees, NOT uniform interior-volume points of the spanning-tree polytope.
Unweighted complete-split graph and ambient standard edge metric essential; other graph classes not covered.

Those results do not directly diagonalize the complete-split graph covariance nor prove a universal p-independent q=3 change of principal eigenspace.
